Welcome to the Directorate General of Immigration & Passports, Ministry of Interior, Government of Pakistan. Our department is committed to enhancing the quality and efficiency of immigration and passport services. Through the integration of technology, upgraded facilities, refined procedures, strategic enhancements, and digital transformation, we aim to ensure effortless and streamlined processes for all our stakeholders. Syed Mohsin Raza Naqvi Minister of Interior Capt. (Retd.) Muhammad Khurram Agha Secretary Interior Ch. Muhammad Ali Randhawa Director General of DGI&P News & Updates 16 Aug 2023 The Inland Online Passport Renewal facility is available 16 Aug 2023 e-Passport issuance facility is available all across Pakistan 1 July 2026 E-Passport Replace Ordinary Passport 1 July 2026 Cashless Passport Fee Payment 1 July 2026 Home Delivery Service - Passport at your doorstep 6 May 2026 Show Cause Notice Deportee 26 Jan 2026 Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi inaugurates SHIKRA monitoring system at Immigration & Passports‎ 25 Feb 2025 Uniform Photo Waived for Armed Forces on Ordinary Passports 06 Jan 2025 Fast Track Passport Service has been extended to 26 more cities 30 Dec 2024 Nationwide Passport Printing Backlog has been Eliminated 31 Oct 2024 Passport Office Jurisdiction Policy has been revised 08 May 2024 The Fast Track Category (MRP) Fee has also been revised 06 May 2024 24/7 facility available in Islamabad, Lahore & Karachi ( Read More ) DGI&P Services Passport Visa Immigration Policy Every Citizen of Pakistan is entitled to Machine Readable Passport for traveling abroad, subject to completion of all codal formalities. Important Note Process The applicant will go through the all stages at Regional Passport Office (RPO), for obtaining Machine Readable Passport (MRP) as mentioned in the above link Fee Passport Fees can be paid online now. For more info click on the given link. e-Payment (Passport Fee Asaan) MRV The DGI&P is responsible for granting/extending Machine Readable Visas (MRV) to foreign nationals from (DGI&P's Headquarter) & zonal offices in Lahore (Garden Town), Peshawar, Quetta and Karachi (Saddar). e-Visa Pakistan Online Visa System is now open for the citizens of 192 Countries! Citizens from 120 countries can apply for a Visa Prior to Arrival for Business, Tourism, or Sikh Pilgrimage. 06 GCC countries are exempt from visa requirements for these categories. Visa Fee Visa Fee is always charged on reciprocal basis of the respective country. Click ' Read More ' for details. Citizenship (a) Grant of Citizenship (b) Naturalization Renunciation Persons who can acquire citizenship of other countries after applying in the prescribed manner shall make a declaration of renunciation of citizenship of Pakistan, details are mentioned in the above link. Downloads Various immigration forms can be downloaded from here. Click ' Read More ' for details.
